content.short: Wigwam App is a secure, self-custodial MPC wallet that makes it easy to track, buy, and trade tokens across the crypto market and supports all EVM.
content.description: The Wigwam App is a secure, self-custodial MPC wallet that gives beginners easy entry to crypto tokens on decentralized exchanges. It supports a broad set of networks, enabling access to tokens across multiple ecosystems. With MPC-based key management, you retain control of your funds while enjoying a streamlined onboarding experience and reduced exposure of private keys. Designed with beginners in mind, Wigwam offers a straightforward way to buy and trade tokens.
content.meta: Wigwam App is a secure, self-custodial MPC wallet for tracking, buying, and trading tokens. Discover Wigwam App and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
